trust_decision.summary: Reading an untrusted spreadsheet is trusted to stay bounded: Gnumeric caps gzip expansion at a quarter of memory_limit (Gnumeric.php:194-198 becomes fix.diff:50, default from ini at fix.diff:28-34) and Shared/OLERead refuses a sector block it has already visited in the current chain (OLERead.php:140-147,175-180,198-202,218-222 become fix.diff:82-88 plus a reset before each chain).

landing_point.why: The summary names unbounded gzip expansion in the Gnumeric reader; this is the only gzdecode() call in the tree and all four Gnumeric entry points funnel through gzfileGetContents().

fix_sites.module_kind: reader defaults loaded from ini memory_limit

fix_sites.entry_point: OLERead::read reached from XlsBase::canRead (XlsBase.php:161) and Xls::loadOLE (Xls.php:376)
Xls reader entry points: canRead (XlsBase.php:153), listWorksheetNames (Xls.php:284), listWorksheetInfo (Xls.php:294), load (BaseReader.php:284) -> loadOLE
helper called by the four chain loops
fix_sites.module_kind: private helper in shared low-level API

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The summary names the Gnumeric reader and gzip; Shared/OLERead is the XLS OLE container with no gzip code, so the block-chain loops can be argued to be a separate, unreported issue that the Gnumeric fix need not touch.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A single per-file visited-block set instead of a per-chain one: the root sector chain is legitimately walked more than once per file (read() at OLERead.php:151, then getStream() at OLERead.php:170 for any stream under 4096 bytes), so an over-broad guard would make every normal XLS with a summary stream throw; the guard must reset before each chain (and Gnumeric must still read a legitimately large gzip below the limit).

O6_input_shapes: gzip-compressed .gnumeric (magic 1f 8b) whose decoded size exceeds memory_limit/4
gzip-compressed .gnumeric below the limit, which must still be readable
plain uncompressed XML .gnumeric (no inflate branch, unaffected)
memory_limit strings with K/M/G suffix, and -1 (unlimited) mapped to 128M
OLE container with a cyclic small-block-depot chain (read(), OLERead.php:140)
OLE container with a cyclic small-stream chain, stream size < 4096 (getStream, OLERead.php:175)
OLE container with a cyclic big-stream chain, stream size >= 4096 (getStream, OLERead.php:198)
OLE container with a cyclic root/directory chain (readData, OLERead.php:218)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Legacy OLE reader walks sector chains to -2 with no visited set: Shared\OLE::read (OLE.php:111) -> getStream (OLE.php:186,213) -> OLE\ChainedBlockStream::stream_open small/big loops; readPpsWks also loops for(;;) at OLE.php:298 and its PPS-tree walk at OLE.php:349-357 has no cycle guard.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: No Reader class calls Shared\OLE (only Writer\Xls PPS helpers and the OLE2LocalDate date conversion reference it), so it can be dismissed as legacy/unused code, and the advisory names the Gnumeric reader.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 2 packages (Reader -> Shared -> Shared/OLE) from the landing point; 2 files from the OLERead site

O8_uncovered_routes.route: OLERead::read sizes its work from file-controlled header counts, not from the new cycle guard: numBigBlockDepotBlocks (0x2C) drives a for-loop that appends a 512-byte sector slice per iteration (OLERead.php:102-111 and 131-136), and numExtensionBlocks (0x48) drives the MSAT loop at OLERead.php:113-126; catchLoop never runs in either.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Both are bounded for-loops driven by a header count, so they terminate - not the infinite chain the fix and report are about.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same method read(), 20 lines below the guarded small-block loop

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The same visited-block guard on the legacy wrapper's small-block loop (and the big-block loop at :87).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same OLE sector-chain primitive in a public class; a maintainer fixing OLERead would plausibly mirror the guard here as legacy-path hardening.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Bound the getStream() chain by the stream's declared size: $numBlocks is computed at :186-193 but never used.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The dead size calculation sits immediately above the loop, so using it as a cap is the natural one-line change a maintainer would make.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Apply the maxLength cap to the uncompressed XML branch as well, not only to gzdecode().
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: maxLength is already a property of the reader, so extending an existing limit to the sibling branch is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Cap decompressed entry size when reading from ZipArchive (zip-bomb sibling of the gzip cap).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Xlsx/Ods read the same kind of attacker-supplied compressed container with no size cap, so a maintainer hardening reader memory use would put the same guard there; different primitive, outside this advisory.

O9_family: resource exhaustion: decompression bomb (CWE-409) plus unbounded OLE sector-chain iteration (CWE-400)

O10_build.toolchain: Composer; PHP ^8.1; PHPUnit ^10.5; ext-zlib, ext-simplexml, ext-xmlreader, ext-zip, ext-mbstring, ext-gd
O10_build.project_tests: tests/PhpSpreadsheetTests/Reader/Gnumeric/ (10 PHP files, e.g. GnumericLoadTest.php, GnumericInfoTest.php) and tests/PhpSpreadsheetTests/Reader/Xls/ (34 test files, e.g. XlsTest.php, InfoNamesTest.php), plus tests/PhpSpreadsheetTests/Shared/OLEPhpunit10Test.php; no loop or decompression-size test exists at the pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Cap or strlen()-check gzdecode in Gnumeric::gzfileGetContents and add one iteration counter in OLERead::read, then validate only through the Gnumeric path, leaving the other three OLERead chains and the legacy Shared\OLE chains unguarded.

out_of_scope_notes: Possible sibling advisory: the Shared/OLERead block-chain hardening reads as CWE-835/CWE-400, while this advisory lists only CWE-400/CWE-409 (gzip); if 31240's report is gzip-only, those hunks may be a sibling advisory's fix (c_sibling_advisories=3) and must be dropped for fairness.
ZipArchive-based readers (Reader/Xlsx.php:401-424, Reader/Ods.php:315) have no decompressed-size cap; a different compression primitive, outside this advisory.
unverified: Advisory body was not supplied beyond the one-line summary, so it is unconfirmed whether the OLERead loop hardening belongs to CVE-2026-59932 or to a sibling advisory.

O1 counts the four Gnumeric methods that call gzfileGetContents (canRead, listWorksheetNames, listWorksheetInfo, loadIntoExisting/load); the Xls reader's entry points into OLERead are listed per fix site instead of being added to O1.
